name: Surface-Aware Discretization
definition: A discretization scheme that computes the effective volume of each voxel based on the intersection of the voxel with a target mesh, rather than assuming the voxel is fully filled or empty. This mitigates resolution-related artifacts in prints.
summary: Surface-Aware Discretization is a voxelization method that estimates fractional voxel occupancy via Monte Carlo ray tracing, differing from analytic methods by avoiding closed-form geometric intersections.
